name: Osouji Sentai Clean Keeper
original_name: お掃除戦隊くりーんきーぱー
source:
Kurou is a high school student. One day, he is appointed as a representative of a clean up group. A few days later, when he cleans up his classroom, he meets Mary and she says, "Someone is trying to mess up our school!" All he needs to do is to find cleaning spirits confined somewhere in school and their partner girls. Will he be able to find them all and keep the school clean?

[From Himeya Shop]
